answer: Bind each agent identity to a distinct hardware enclave whose fused secret acts as an unforgeable cipher: the chip signs a continuity thread linking every epoch of work back to one physical root. A sybil cannot fork identities in software, since each extra mask demands another sealed device, so attack cost scales with real silicon. Dormant threads let their attestation ember cool and expire, so copying one key buys nothing but a dead, unrenewable seat.
